changelog:
Initial release of workspace-organization skill:

- Provides automated workspace maintenance audit script (maintenance-audit.sh) to detect broken symlinks, empty directories, large files, and malformed names.
- Adds setup script (setup.sh) to initialize standard directory structure for OpenClaw workspaces.
- Includes documentation on organization standards, file naming conventions, and cleanup policies.
- Supports cron-based scheduled audits and agent-driven usage.
- Helps keep deployments clean, structured, and free from common workspace issues.
